the SI method is effective in enhancing the recall of the major and nonmajor phrases of narrative texts, but that the CP method has no such effect on recall.

students who generated guesses about the content of a narrative passage before reading the passage recalled more major phrases and other passage information than students who read a content summary or who read the passage without any prior activity.

Story Impressions (a generative prereading strategy) significantly increased recall of the major and minor phrases of the narrative text, whereas Content Previews (a more passive prereading strategy) did not increase the recall of the major or minor phrases of the text.
